ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The Gospel passages (Matthew 19:16, 21; 19:23–24) are translated from the Russian wording, not from an English Bible. In Chrysostom's passage «сребролюбие» (srebrolyubie) is held as 'love of money', and «истуканы» (istukany, 'graven images') is kept distinct from «идолы» (idoly, 'idols'); «Демофил» (Demofil) is 'Demophilus'.
